blocks.text: VISA MASTER — UNOFFICIAL. Complete the official PDF locally. Copy passport fields exactly, never guess, and sign only after every answer agrees with the supporting evidence.

rows: Copy exactly from the travel document, including former surname only when applicable.
Use genuine civil records and tick the applicable status.
Not applicable to an adult unless the form instruction says otherwise.
Complete sensitive data locally only when applicable.
Choose Ordinary Passport and copy number, issue date, expiry, and issuer exactly.
Use current genuine details consistent with the employer letter and business licence.
Choose Tourism and briefly describe the genuine trip.
Use the actual itinerary. Spain must genuinely be the main destination for this route.
Answer truthfully; do not invent dates or permit data.
Use genuine accommodation contacts; company invitation is normally inapplicable to self-arranged tourism.
Choose the genuine funding source and means, consistent with financial evidence.
Complete the preparer only when different; review all facts before signing locally.

documents.title: Employer Letter Template
documents.subtitle: UNOFFICIAL editable template — issue on genuine company letterhead

blocks.text: VISA MASTER — UNOFFICIAL. The employer must verify, issue, stamp, sign, and date the final letter. Never invent company facts, salary, leave, stamp, or signature.
[COMPANY LETTERHEAD]
Date: [DD MONTH YYYY]
To: Consulate General of Spain in Chengdu
Employment and Approved Leave Confirmation

This confirms that [APPLICANT FULL NAME AS IN PASSPORT] has been employed by [COMPANY LEGAL NAME] as [JOB TITLE] since [START DATE / YEARS OF SERVICE]. Their genuine current salary is [SALARY, CURRENCY, AND PERIOD].
The company approves leave from [LEAVE START] through [LEAVE END] for private tourism in Spain. [APPLICANT NAME] is expected to resume work on [RETURN-TO-WORK DATE].
[IF TRUE, STATE WHO PAYS TRAVEL AND LIVING COSTS; OTHERWISE DELETE.]
Company contact details
Issue in English, or attach an English translation to a Chinese letter. Add the separate sealed/stamped company business-licence copy.

documents.title: Optional Applicant Cover Letter Template
documents.subtitle: UNOFFICIAL — use only when a concise supported explanation helps

blocks.text: VISA MASTER — UNOFFICIAL. Delete this document if it adds nothing useful. Replace every placeholder with truthful, documented facts.
Date: [DATE]
To: Consulate General of Spain in Chengdu
Subject: Short-stay Schengen visa application for tourism
Dear Visa Officer,
I am applying for a short-stay Schengen visa for genuine tourism in Spain from [ARRIVAL] to [DEPARTURE]. My itinerary, accommodation, and transport evidence cover the trip.
I work as [JOB TITLE] for [EMPLOYER]. My employer has approved leave, supported by the attached employer letter and company document.
Travel and living costs will be paid by [TRUTHFUL FUNDING SOURCE]. [ADD A SHORT DOCUMENT-SUPPORTED EXPLANATION ONLY IF NEEDED.]
I will return to China and resume work on [RETURN-TO-WORK DATE].
Thank you for considering my application.
